name: Vista Global Holding (VistaJet, XO)
note: Dubai-headquartered private aviation group; owns VistaJet and XO (rhonegroup.com portfolio page). Founded by entrepreneur Thomas Flohr (Rhône). An RRJ Capital-led consortium with Andalusian Private Capital agreed a $600m equity investment in March 2025, joining the company's existing investor base (Private Jet Card Comparisons, 2025-03-17). Rhône Group has held a stake in Vista Global since August 2017 and still lists it in its portfolio (rhonegroup.com).
